en: The image shows the back side of an old, yellowed postcard with printed French heading "CARTE POSTALE" and the phrase "Ce côté est exclusivement réservé à l'adresse". Below, in elegant red cursive handwriting, the card is addressed in Spanish to "Sr. D. Benito Pérez Galdós" with the address "Rambla de Cataluña, Interior". At the top there is a penciled numeric note "25–89–1 – D". The card has no visible stamp or picture side in this view.
